description:
Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust

Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust.
An open-source, clean-room take on the Adobe Premiere Pro workflow: native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly. By the ArtCraft team.
Premiere 26's full Video Effects bin (93 effects in 16 folders), the Legacy bin and the obsolete effects old projects use, plus around 30 transitions.
What's Changed
- Grant network access so update checks can reach GitHub by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3527
- Honor CARGO_BUILD_TARGET in FreeBSD packaging for aarch64 release builds by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3534
- CI: workflows only call craft-common-actions at @main (AGENTS.md; windows-arm64 unpinned) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3645
- Project panel: search finds names holding every typed word by @punkhop in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3327
- #2798: contain Symphonia audio decoder panics by @thecyberbutler in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3338
- Reject non-PCM WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE files in parse_wav by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3344
- macOS: declare the UI languages so the open and save panels are translated by @Atalantis in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3373
- #3364: warn about one-frame In/Out exports by @thecyberbutler in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3402
- engine: Duplicate puts the copy in the bin of its source (#3368) by @x-labb in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3405
- speech: a pause inside a word's span ends the word (#3346) by @tdog37 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3347
- engine: effects.addKeyframe keeps an explicit time at the out point and says what it did (#3386) by @x-labb in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3409

- gpu: create wgpu instances without OpenGL so concurrent device setup cannot deadlock (#3418) by @iannitram in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3548
- Fix graphics template width scaling across canvas sizes (#3415) by @thecyberbutler in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3565
- Update prompt shows the app icon and accent color instead of a letter by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3663
- Program Monitor: Snap in Program Monitor applies to video clip Motion drags by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3584
- Effect Controls: Font and Font Style of a text layer are picked from drop-downs by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3588
- Audio Track Mixer: a fader moved during playback in Read mode keeps its level by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3590
- Synchronize: Clip > Synchronize (Audio) works on long stereo clips by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3591
